title: On the Scaling Laws of Geographical Representation in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Training linear regression probes on the hidden representations of various language models to predict the latitude and longitude of prompted locations. The bias is evaluated by measuring the Mean Squared Error (MSE) of predicted coordinates across different continents, calculating the Gini coefficient to measure performance heterogeneity across countries, and correlating the probe performance with geographical factors like latitude and the frequency of country names in the pretraining data.
